tasks.title: Initialize Next.js 15 Project with TypeScript
tasks.description: Set up a new Next.js 15 project with TypeScript support.
tasks.details:
Use the following commands to initialize the project:

```bash
npx create-next-app@latest smartmarketooops-dashboard --typescript
cd smartmarketooops-dashboard
```

Ensure that the project structure is set up correctly with TypeScript configuration.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the project compiles without errors and that TypeScript is correctly configured by running `npm run dev` and checking for any TypeScript errors in the console.

tasks.title: Set Up Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui
tasks.description: Integrate Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components into the Next.js project.
tasks.details:
Follow the official Tailwind CSS installation guide for Next.js:

```bash
npm install -D tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer
npx tailwindcss init -p
```

Configure `tailwind.config.js` and `globals.css` as per Tailwind CSS documentation. Install shadcn/ui components:

```bash
npm install @shadcn/ui
```

Import shadcn/ui styles in `globals.css`.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components are correctly integrated by creating a sample component and applying Tailwind CSS classes and shadcn/ui components.

tasks.title: Configure Development Environment
tasks.description: Set up the development environment with necessary tools and configurations.
tasks.details:
Install ESLint and Prettier for code linting and formatting:

```bash
npm install --save-dev eslint prettier eslint-config-prettier eslint-plugin-react eslint-plugin-react-hooks eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y eslint-plugin-import
```

Create `.eslintrc.json` and `.prettierrc` configuration files. Set up VSCode settings for consistent development environment.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that ESLint and Prettier are correctly configured by running `npm run lint` and `npm run format` and checking for any linting or formatting errors.

tasks.title: Create Basic Project Structure
tasks.description: Set up the initial folder structure for the project.
tasks.details:
Create the following folders and files:

```plaintext
/components/
/pages/
/styles/
public/
```

Set up basic file structure for components, pages, styles, and public assets.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the project structure is correctly set up by checking the folder and file organization.

tasks.title: Build Reusable UI Component Library
tasks.description: Develop a set of reusable UI components using shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS.
tasks.details: Create a `components` folder and start building reusable components such as buttons, modals, cards, etc. Use shadcn/ui components as a base and customize them with Tailwind CSS.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the reusable components are correctly implemented by using them in sample pages and checking for consistent styling and functionality.

tasks.title: Implement Responsive Layout System
tasks.description: Set up a responsive layout system using Tailwind CSS.
tasks.details: Use Tailwind CSS's responsive utility classes to create a flexible and responsive layout system. Ensure that the layout adapts to different screen sizes and devices.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the responsive layout system works correctly by testing the application on different devices and screen sizes.

tasks.title: Create Navigation and Routing Structure
tasks.description: Set up the navigation and routing structure for the application.
tasks.details: Use Next.js's file-based routing system to create the navigation structure. Create a `components/Navbar.js` file for the navigation bar and set up links to different pages.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the navigation and routing structure works correctly by navigating through the application and checking for proper routing.

tasks.title: Setup Theme System (Dark/Light)
tasks.description: Implement a theme system that supports dark and light modes.
tasks.details: Use Tailwind CSS's dark mode support to implement a theme system. Create a `components/ThemeToggle.js` file to toggle between dark and light modes.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the theme system works correctly by toggling between dark and light modes and checking for consistent styling.

tasks.title: Implement Basic Animations
tasks.description: Add basic animations to the application using Framer Motion.
tasks.details:
Install Framer Motion:

```bash
npm install framer-motion
```

Use Framer Motion to add basic animations to components such as buttons, modals, and transitions.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the basic animations work correctly by checking for smooth transitions and animations in the application.

tasks.title: Build Main Dashboard Layout
tasks.description: Create the main layout for the trading dashboard.
tasks.details: Design the main dashboard layout using Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components. Include sections for portfolio overview, active positions, recent trades, and market overview.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the main dashboard layout is correctly implemented by checking the layout and design consistency.

tasks.title: Implement Portfolio Overview Components
tasks.description: Develop components for displaying portfolio overview information.
tasks.details: Create components to display real-time portfolio balance, asset allocation, and performance metrics. Use Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components for styling.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the portfolio overview components work correctly by checking for accurate data display and consistent styling.

tasks.title: Create Position Monitoring Interface
tasks.description: Develop an interface for monitoring active positions.
tasks.details: Create a grid or table to display active positions with real-time updates on P&L, entry price, and other relevant metrics. Use Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components for styling.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the position monitoring interface works correctly by checking for real-time updates and accurate data display.

tasks.title: Add Real-Time Data Integration
tasks.description: Integrate real-time data streaming using Socket.io.
tasks.details:
Install Socket.io client:

```bash
npm install socket.io-client
```

Set up WebSocket connections to receive real-time market data, trade execution updates, and portfolio balance changes.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that real-time data integration works correctly by checking for real-time updates in the application.

tasks.title: Integrate TradingView Lightweight Charts
tasks.description: Add TradingView Lightweight Charts for professional charting.
tasks.details:
Install TradingView Lightweight Charts:

```bash
npm install lightweight-charts
```

Integrate the charts into the application and set up the initial configuration for displaying candlestick charts.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that TradingView Lightweight Charts are correctly integrated by checking for proper chart display and functionality.

tasks.title: Build Multi-Timeframe Chart Interface
tasks.description: Create an interface for switching between different timeframes.
tasks.details: Develop a UI component that allows users to switch between different timeframes (5m, 15m, 1h, 4h, 1d) and update the chart accordingly. Use Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components for styling.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the multi-timeframe chart interface works correctly by switching between timeframes and checking for accurate chart updates.

tasks.title: Add Technical Indicator Overlays
tasks.description: Integrate technical indicators into the charts.
tasks.details: Use TradingView Lightweight Charts' API to add technical indicators such as moving averages, RSI, MACD, etc. Create a UI component to toggle indicators on and off.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that technical indicator overlays work correctly by toggling indicators and checking for accurate display on the charts.

tasks.title: Implement ML Model Visualization
tasks.description: Add overlays for ML model predictions on the charts.
tasks.details: Integrate ML model prediction data into the charts using TradingView Lightweight Charts' API. Create visual overlays to display model predictions and confidence scores.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that ML model visualization works correctly by checking for accurate display of model predictions and confidence scores on the charts.

tasks.title: Create Interactive Chart Controls
tasks.description: Develop interactive controls for the charts.
tasks.details: Add controls for zooming, panning, and selecting time ranges on the charts. Use Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components for styling the controls.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that interactive chart controls work correctly by testing zooming, panning, and time range selection functionalities.

tasks.title: Build AI Model Monitoring Dashboard
tasks.description: Create a dashboard for monitoring AI model performance.
tasks.details: Develop components to display model performance metrics, prediction accuracy, confidence scores, and market regime analysis. Use Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components for styling.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the AI model monitoring dashboard works correctly by checking for accurate data display and consistent styling.

tasks.title: Implement Real-Time Prediction Display
tasks.description: Add real-time display of model predictions.
tasks.details: Integrate real-time prediction data into the AI model monitoring dashboard. Use Socket.io for real-time data streaming and update the dashboard accordingly.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that real-time prediction display works correctly by checking for real-time updates and accurate data display.

tasks.title: Create Model Performance Analytics
tasks.description: Develop analytics for model performance.
tasks.details: Create components to display model performance analytics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score. Use Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components for styling.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that model performance analytics work correctly by checking for accurate data display and consistent styling.

tasks.title: Add Confidence Score Visualization
tasks.description: Visualize confidence scores for model predictions.
tasks.details: Create visualizations to display confidence scores for model predictions. Use Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components for styling.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that confidence score visualization works correctly by checking for accurate display and consistent styling.

tasks.title: Implement Trade Signal Monitoring
tasks.description: Add monitoring for trade signals generated by the model.
tasks.details: Create components to display trade signals generated by the model. Use Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components for styling.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that trade signal monitoring works correctly by checking for accurate display and consistent styling.

tasks.title: Optimize Bundle Sizes and Performance
tasks.description: Optimize the application for performance.
tasks.details: Use Next.js's built-in optimization features such as code splitting, lazy loading, and image optimization. Analyze and optimize bundle sizes using tools like Webpack Bundle Analyzer.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the application performs well by checking load times, bundle sizes, and overall performance metrics.

tasks.title: Conduct Thorough Testing and Deployment
tasks.description: Test the application thoroughly and deploy it.
tasks.details: Conduct unit testing, integration testing, and end-to-end testing using tools like Jest, React Testing Library, and Cypress. Deploy the application to a production environment using Vercel or another hosting provider.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the application works correctly in the production environment by conducting thorough testing and checking for any issues.
